text: not sure if this is silly but my granddaughter is 1 month old and her temp is 39.8. shes very floppy tonight and I can hardly wake her, when I do she doesn't really look at me or react like she usually does. about 10 mins ago she went stiff and her arms and legs were shaking and her eyes rolled up, never done that before. it stopped on its own. her mum's in the shower, I don't know if this is normal for a baby
